topic: Can DNA act as an information storage medium?
academic_reframing: Under an explicit archival-service contract, can an in-vitro DNA system preserve and selectively recover digital payloads with a defensible integrity, durability, latency, and cost boundary?

excludes: a claim that DNA replaces RAM or SSDs
a claim of universal cost superiority
new DNA sequence synthesis or experimental execution in this proposal

direct_support: arbitrary digital encoding and sequencing-based readback
evidence_summary.open_frontier: A portable, end-to-end archive service contract that makes accepted recovery, rather than raw molecular density, the primary evaluation target.
